name: Health answers signed out, and an unknown case shows 404 once signed in
description: Validates the public health check as a browser shows it (JSON with the app up and the recorder, collector and feed check states, a query string refused) while signed out, then signs in and checks that an unknown case slug shows the 404 page instead of a broken console. The health check's status codes are checked by testsprite/backend/health_endpoint.py.

planSteps.description: Assert the response is JSON with "app": "up", a "status" of "ok" or "degraded", "recorder" and "collector" objects, and a "crossSource" list
Assert the page shows the JSON {"ok":false,"reason":"the health check takes no query string"} and no health report (no "app" or "recorder" field)
In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in
Wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Assert the page shows "404" and "This page could not be found.", and no replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown
